import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createPluginHost, definePlugin } from '@nodebraid/runtime-cordis';
import { createBasicCanvasPlugin } from '@nodebraid/preset-basic';
import { commandService, defineCommand } from '@nodebraid/plugin-command';
import { interactionShortcutService } from '@nodebraid/plugin-interaction';
class RecordingRenderer {
    subscriptions = new Map();
    disposed = false;
    updateDocument(_update) { }
    updateSession(_snapshot) { }
    updateInteraction() { }
    subscribeInput(listener, decide) {
        this.subscriptions.set(listener, decide);
        return () => { this.subscriptions.delete(listener); };
    }
    hitTest(point) { return { type: 'canvas', worldPoint: point }; }
    capturePointer(_id) { }
    releasePointer(_id) { }
    focus() { }
    dispose() { this.disposed = true; this.subscriptions.clear(); return Promise.resolve(); }
    emit(input) {
        let control, behavior;
        const entries = Array.from(this.subscriptions);
        for (const [, decide] of entries)
            control = decide?.(input) ?? control;
        for (const [listener] of entries)
            behavior = listener(input) ?? behavior;
        return { control, behavior };
    }
}
const output = process.env.NODEBRAID_SHORTCUT_CLASSIFICATION_RESULTS;
assert.ok(output);
const rows = [];
const unhandled = [];
const onUnhandled = (error) => { unhandled.push(error); };
process.on('unhandledRejection', onUnhandled);
const turn = () => new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve));
const capture = (promise) => promise.then(value => ({ ok: true, value }), error => ({ ok: false, error: error }));
try {
    for (const route of ['direct-command-proxy-control', 'shortcut-ordinary-error-control', 'shortcut-proxy-rejection']) {
        const renderer = new RecordingRenderer();
        const faults = [];
        const host = createPluginHost({ diagnostics: { faultReporter(fault) { faults.push(fault); } } });
        let commands, shortcuts;
        const composition = host.install(createBasicCanvasPlugin(() => renderer));
        const consumer = host.install(definePlugin({
            requires: { commands: commandService, shortcuts: interactionShortcutService },
            setup(context) { commands = context.services.commands; shortcuts = context.services.shortcuts; },
        }));
        await Promise.all([composition.whenActive(), consumer.whenActive()]);
        const original = new Error('caller-owned Command rejection');
        const inspectionFailure = new Error('native getPrototypeOf failed');
        let prototypeReads = 0;
        const proxy = new Proxy(original, { getPrototypeOf() { prototypeReads++; throw inspectionFailure; } });
        const failure = route === 'shortcut-ordinary-error-control' ? original : proxy;
        let handlerCalls = 0;
        const command = defineCommand('probe.classification/' + route);
        const commandRegistration = commands.register(command, () => { handlerCalls++; throw failure; });
        const startUnhandled = unhandled.length;
        if (route === 'direct-command-proxy-control') {
            const result = await capture(commands.execute(command, undefined));
            const passed = !result.ok && Object.is(result.error, proxy) && prototypeReads === 0;
            await commandRegistration.dispose();
            await host.dispose();
            rows.push({ route, passed, originalIdentity: !result.ok && Object.is(result.error, proxy), prototypeReads, handlerCalls,
                commandRegistrationDisposed: true, hostDisposed: true, rendererDisposed: renderer.disposed });
        }
        else {
            const binding = { shortcut: { code: 'KeyP', modifierAlternatives: [{ alt: false, control: false, meta: false, shift: false }] }, command };
            const registration = shortcuts.register(binding);
            const disposition = renderer.emit({ type: 'key.down', key: 'p', code: 'KeyP', repeat: false,
                modifiers: { alt: false, control: false, meta: false, shift: false } });
            assert.deepEqual(disposition, { control: { defaultAction: 'prevent' }, behavior: { defaultAction: 'prevent' } });
            await turn();
            await turn();
            let commandDisposed = false;
            const commandDisposal = commandRegistration.dispose().then(() => { commandDisposed = true; });
            await turn();
            await turn();
            if (commandDisposed)
                await commandDisposal;
            let bindingDisposed = false;
            const bindingDisposal = registration.dispose().then(() => { bindingDisposed = true; });
            await turn();
            await turn();
            let reservationReleased = false;
            let fresh;
            let conflictCode;
            try {
                fresh = shortcuts.register(binding);
                reservationReleased = true;
            }
            catch (error) {
                conflictCode = error !== null && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error ? error.code : undefined;
            }
            if (fresh)
                await fresh.dispose();
            const ownUnhandled = unhandled.slice(startUnhandled);
            const originalFaultPreserved = faults.some(fault => Object.is(fault.error, failure));
            const faultError = faults.length === 1 ? faults[0].error : undefined;
            const descriptor = (typeof faultError === 'object' && faultError !== null) || typeof faultError === 'function'
                ? Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(faultError, 'errors') : undefined;
            const members = descriptor && 'value' in descriptor ? descriptor.value : undefined;
            const compoundOriginalAndInspectionSlotsPreserved = Array.isArray(members) && members.length === 2
                && Object.is(members[0], failure) && Object.is(members[1], inspectionFailure)
                && faultError instanceof AggregateError;
            const exactlyOneFault = faults.length === 1;
            const stableCommandFaultMetadata = exactlyOneFault
                && faults[0].event.name === 'nodebraid.plugin.interaction.command.fault'
                && faults[0].event.level === 'error'
                && faults[0].event.attributes.commandId === command.id
                && faults[0].event.scope.pluginName === '@nodebraid/plugin-interaction'
                && typeof faults[0].event.scope.hostId === 'string' && faults[0].event.scope.hostId.length > 0
                && typeof faults[0].event.scope.installationId === 'string' && faults[0].event.scope.installationId.length > 0
                && typeof faults[0].event.scope.activationId === 'string' && faults[0].event.scope.activationId.length > 0
                && Object.isFrozen(faults[0]) && Object.isFrozen(faults[0].event)
                && Object.isFrozen(faults[0].event.scope) && Object.isFrozen(faults[0].event.attributes);
            const requiredIdentityStagePreserved = route === 'shortcut-proxy-rejection'
                ? compoundOriginalAndInspectionSlotsPreserved : originalFaultPreserved;
            let hostDisposed = false;
            const hostDisposal = host.dispose().then(() => { hostDisposed = true; });
            await turn();
            await turn();
            if (hostDisposed)
                await hostDisposal;
            if (bindingDisposed)
                await bindingDisposal;
            const passed = handlerCalls === 1 && commandDisposed && requiredIdentityStagePreserved && exactlyOneFault && stableCommandFaultMetadata && bindingDisposed && reservationReleased && ownUnhandled.length === 0 && hostDisposed && renderer.disposed && renderer.subscriptions.size === 0;
            rows.push({ route, passed, handlerCalls, prototypeReads, faults: faults.length, originalFaultPreserved, compoundOriginalAndInspectionSlotsPreserved, exactlyOneFault, stableCommandFaultMetadata, requiredIdentityStagePreserved,
                faultEventName: faults[0]?.event.name, faultCommandId: faults[0]?.event.attributes.commandId, faultScope: faults[0]?.event.scope,
                unhandledRejections: ownUnhandled.length, unhandledIsInspectionFailure: ownUnhandled.some(error => Object.is(error, inspectionFailure)),
                commandRegistrationDisposed: commandDisposed, bindingDisposed, reservationReleased, conflictCode,
                hostDisposed, rendererDisposed: renderer.disposed, remainingRendererSubscriptions: renderer.subscriptions.size,
                observation: 'Each public disposal attempted; state read after actual handler rejection and finite native event-loop turns. A pending public Promise is not reported as cleanup success.' });
        }
        writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) + '\n');
        console.log(JSON.stringify(rows.at(-1)));
    }
    assert.equal(rows.length, 3);
    assert.equal(rows.filter(row => row.passed).length, 3, 'Shortcut classification must not replace a caller rejection, strand finished execution ownership, or retain its Binding reservation.');
}
catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
    throw error;
}
finally {
    await turn();
    process.off('unhandledRejection', onUnhandled);
}
//# sourceMappingURL=shortcut-rejection-compound-oracle-v3.js.map
